name: GrowthSystemsHQ Painting Quote Calculator
author: growthplugins

sections.description:
Painting Quote Calculator helps painting contractors and service businesses add a simple online painting estimate calculator to their WordPress website.

Visitors can enter room dimensions, number of doors, windows, painting coats and other project information to receive an estimated painting cost.

The plugin also allows website owners to collect customer quote requests directly from the calculator.

Features

  • Interior and exterior project types
  • Room dimensions
  • Wall area calculation
  • Door and window pricing
  • Multiple paint coats
  • Surface preparation pricing
  • Live estimate calculation
  • Customer quote request form
  • Email notifications
  • Quote request management
  • Responsive design
  • Simple shortcode integration

Usage

Add the following shortcode to any WordPress page:

[gshqpqc_painting_quote]

Privacy

The plugin stores quote request information submitted by website visitors in the WordPress database.

Website owners are responsible for informing visitors about how submitted information is collected and used.

Paid Add Ons

Take your painting quote workflow further with GrowthSystemsHQ paid add-ons.

Professional PDF Quotes

Create professional, branded PDF quotes for your customers with company information, logo, quote validity, terms and notes.

Learn more about the PDF Quote Generator:
https://growthsystemshq.com/pdf-quote-generator/

Automated Quote Follow-Up

Stay connected with potential customers after sending a quote. The Quote Follow-Up & Automation add-on helps you schedule follow-up emails, customize follow-up messages, and maintain a consistent quote follow-up process.

Learn more about Quote Follow-Up & Automation:
https://growthsystemshq.com/quote-follow-up-automation/

Quote Analytics & Conversion Tracking

Understand how your painting quote pipeline is performing. Track quote volume, quote statuses, conversion rates, won revenue, pipeline value, average won quote, project-type performance, and other sales metrics.

Use these insights to understand which types of painting projects generate more opportunities and revenue, monitor your sales pipeline, and identify where potential customers are dropping out of the quote process.

Learn more about Quote Analytics & Conversion Tracking:
https://growthsystemshq.com/quote-analytics/

Support

For plugin support and product information, visit:

https://growthsystemshq.com/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/growthsystemshq-painting-quote-calculator/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Painting Quotes > Settings.
  4. Configure your pricing and notification email.
  5. Add [gshqpqc_painting_quote] to any page.
